#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os, re

ROOT = "/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild"

def strip_comments(text):
    """Return list of (lineno, code_only_line) with Lean comments blanked out."""
    out = []
    i = 0
    n = len(text)
    depth = 0
    line = 1
    buf = []
    lines = {}
    in_str = False
    while i < n:
        c = text[i]
        if c == '\n':
            lines.setdefault(line, [])
            lines[line] = ''.join(buf)
            buf = []
            line += 1
            i += 1
            continue
        if depth > 0:
            if text.startswith('/-', i):
                depth += 1; i += 2; continue
            if text.startswith('-/', i):
                depth -= 1; i += 2; continue
            i += 1
            continue
        if in_str:
            if c == '\\':
                i += 2; buf.append('  '); continue
            if c == '"':
                in_str = False
            buf.append(c); i += 1; continue
        if c == '"':
            in_str = True; buf.append(c); i += 1; continue
        if text.startswith('/-', i):
            depth = 1; i += 2; continue
        if text.startswith('--', i):
            # skip to end of line
            j = text.find('\n', i)
            if j == -1:
                i = n
            else:
                i = j
            continue
        buf.append(c); i += 1
    lines[line] = ''.join(buf)
    return lines

allfiles = []
for dp, dn, fns in os.walk(os.path.join(ROOT, "AlgebraicJacobian")):
    if '.lake' in dp: continue
    for fn in fns:
        if fn.endswith('.lean'):
            allfiles.append(os.path.join(dp, fn))
allfiles.append(os.path.join(ROOT, "AlgebraicJacobian.lean"))
allfiles.sort()

SORRY = re.compile(r'\bsorry\b')
AXIOM = re.compile(r'^\s*(?:@\[[^\]]*\]\s*)?(?:private\s+|protected\s+|noncomputable\s+|scoped\s+)*axiom\b')
NATIVE = re.compile(r'\bnative_decide\b')
IMPL = re.compile(r'@\[[^\]]*implemented_by')
ADMIT = re.compile(r'\b(sorryAx|admit)\b')

challenge = os.path.join(ROOT, "AlgebraicJacobian/Challenge.lean")

res_sorry_other = []
res_sorry_challenge = []
res_axiom = []
res_native = []
res_impl = []
res_admit = []

for p in allfiles:
    text = open(p, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').read()
    lines = strip_comments(text)
    raw = text.split('\n')
    for ln in sorted(lines):
        code = lines[ln]
        if SORRY.search(code):
            entry = (p, ln, raw[ln-1].strip() if ln-1 < len(raw) else '')
            (res_sorry_challenge if p == challenge else res_sorry_other).append(entry)
        if AXIOM.search(code):
            res_axiom.append((p, ln, raw[ln-1].strip()))
        if NATIVE.search(code):
            res_native.append((p, ln, raw[ln-1].strip()))
        if IMPL.search(code):
            res_impl.append((p, ln, raw[ln-1].strip()))
        if ADMIT.search(code):
            res_admit.append((p, ln, raw[ln-1].strip()))

def show(title, rows):
    print(f"=== {title} (count={len(rows)}) ===")
    for p, ln, txt in rows:
        print(f"{p}:{ln}: {txt}")
    print()

show("sorry in CODE, excluding Challenge.lean", res_sorry_other)
show("sorry in CODE, Challenge.lean", res_sorry_challenge)
show("axiom declarations", res_axiom)
show("native_decide", res_native)
show("@[implemented_by]", res_impl)
show("sorryAx / admit", res_admit)
